meta.name: Curb Your Expectations
meta.description: After Krusty's latest marriage ends in spectacular fashion, he swears off love forever, only to discover his perfect match in a familiar face. Can a selfish, emotionally stunted TV clown forge a new family and finally win the love he doesn't deserve?
